theme: 3 terms on tabs: the container, the icon and title of one tab, and the red count on it

terms.definition: A container that shows a bar of tabs at the bottom and switches between screens.
terms.example: Use a Tab Bar Controller, with Home, Search and Profile.

terms.definition: The icon and title of one tab in the tab bar.
terms.example: Set the Tab Bar Item for each screen, with an SF Symbol.
terms.code:
home.tabBarItem = UITabBarItem(
    title: "Home",
    image: UIImage(systemName: "house"),
    selectedImage: nil)

terms.definition: A small red number or dot on an icon that shows something new.
terms.example: Show a Badge with the unread count on the Inbox tab.

quizzes.question: What do you call a small red number on an icon that shows something new?
What container shows a bar of tabs at the bottom and switches screens?
In this code, what holds the title and icon of one tab?
quizzes.code:
home.tabBarItem = UITabBarItem(
    title: "Home", image: nil,
    selectedImage: nil)

video.title: Tab Bar Controller, Tab Bar Item & Badge | Day 108
video.description:
Learn to explain how a tab bar app is put together: Tab Bar Controller, Tab Bar Item & Badge, with real code, a quiz at the end and each example read twice (normal, then slow).

Today's terms
Tab Bar Controller - A container that shows a bar of tabs at the bottom and switches between screens.
Tab Bar Item - The icon and title of one tab in the tab bar.
Badge - A small red number or dot on an icon that shows something new.

Quiz at the end - write your answers in the comments, then watch again to check.

landscape.title: iOS Tab Bar Controller, Tab Bar Item & Badge | Day 108
landscape.description:
Explain Tab Bar Controller, Tab Bar Item & Badge in iOS by listening to a real code chat between two iOS devs.
탭 바 컨트롤러, 탭 바 아이템, 배지 표현을 영어 대화로 익혀요.

Tab Bar Controller - A container that shows a bar of tabs at the bottom and switches between screens.
한국어: 탭 바 컨트롤러: 화면 아래에 탭 바를 보여 주고 화면들을 전환해 주는 컨테이너

Tab Bar Item - The icon and title of one tab in the tab bar.
한국어: 탭 바 아이템: 탭 바에 있는 탭 하나의 아이콘과 제목

Badge - A small red number or dot on an icon that shows something new.
한국어: 배지: 새로운 것이 있음을 보여 주는, 아이콘 위의 작은 빨간 숫자나 점

In this video, Mina and Jake add an unread count to the Inbox tab, in a chat-style conversation, with the Swift code on screen.

landscape.hook: Need a red 3 on a tab? Can you explain how in English?

dialogue.title: A red 3 on the Inbox tab

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Jake, I need a red 3 on the Inbox tab.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: That's a Badge. Set `badgeValue` on its Tab Bar Item.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Is the Tab Bar Item part of the view controller?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Yes. Every screen has a `tabBarItem`, and the Tab Bar Controller reads it.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: What if the count is zero?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Set `badgeValue` to `nil`, and the Badge disappears.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Does the Tab Bar Controller update it automatically?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: No, you set it yourself, usually when new data arrives.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: It's a String, so you can also write 99+.
A Tab Bar Controller switches between your main screens.
